finding: The first 120 hard-arm runs checked rule R after each reveal call; agents revealed many cells in one call (up to 255), so cells after the point where R held were executed and charged (methanation: R at 2 units, median spend 20). This contradicts the preregistered definition ('the run ends at the first action after which R holds'; one cell = one action).
correction: Env.reveal now checks R before every cell in the hard arm and does not execute or charge cells after R holds. No other change.
archived: reveal/archive_hard_batch_flaw/ (120 runs, step logs); excluded from the cell table
gate_arm_unaffected: the gate check was already per cell
